title: Mangaka-san to Assistant-san to THE ANIMATION: Mini OVAs
justification: AniList 20761 has 6 Mini OVAs (2014-06-25 to 2014-11-26). AniDB 10295 S1-S6 'Mini OVA: Ashisu-san's Day Off / We Won't Know Unless We Try', 'Mangaka's Dream', 'Studying on a Date', 'Protect the Cute', 'Sister VS Editor-in-Chief', 'Perfect Nap / Angry Assistant' on 2014-06-25, 07-23, 08-27, 09-24, 10-29, 11-26. TVDB 278976 0x01-0x06 carry the same six titles on the same dates; TMDB tv/69217 S0E1-6 likewise.
